name: sottos-payload
description: Codex plugin for the hosted Sottos Payload CMS MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Draft and edit Sottos blog content through Payload MCP.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to the hosted Sottos Payload CMS MCP server with a blog-safe workflow: posts, tags, and categories can be found, created, and updated; media can be found; delete and user-management tools are intentionally unavailable.
defaultPrompt: Use Sottos Payload CMS to list current blog post titles.
Create a draft Sottos blog post with tags and categories.
Update an existing Sottos blog post draft.
